# Roadmap references: master bibliography

2026-10-08. One entry per distinct work cited by the ten campaign reference lists (`refs_<CODE>.json`), merged, deduplicated and checked against the explorer catalogue, arXiv, zbMATH Open and Crossref under `REFS_VERIFY_BRIEF.md`. Machine version: `references_master.json` (same order, same keys). Campaign files cite these works by short form in their section 8; this file holds the full entries.

Contents: (a) Summary · (b) Acquisition list · (c) The 100 most-used works · (d) For a human to check · (e) Code and formal sources by repository · (f) Full bibliography.

## (a) Summary

- **Works:** 3063 distinct works from 3804 listings in 360 roadmap records: 2547 books, papers and notes; 433 code and formal sources; 58 OpenAI manuscripts; 20 Tau Ceti roadmap READMEs and PRs; 5 web resources.
- **Verification outcomes** (works): unverified (service stopped) 2024; code-local 394; explorer catalogue 197; zbMATH 182; local copy 100; arXiv 94; code (not fetched) 39; Crossref (doi) 20; not found 8; web (not fetched) 5.
- **Requests made:** arXiv 2 (budget 15), zbMATH 203 (cap 2,500), Crossref 28. Stopped services: zbmath.
- **Access** (works): library 1792, arxiv 487, code 433, free 297, purchase 54. `arxiv` means free on arXiv; `free` means free from the author, publisher or an open archive.
- **Held locally:** 48 works have a full local copy (PDF collections or local git); 394 code sources resolve in the local Mathlib, Tau Ceti or OpenAI checkouts.
- **Corrections:** 760 changes to 686 works: access free → library, not checked online 277, scratchpad path dropped 155, DOI added 136, URL set 72, arXiv ID added 47, access free → library, checked online 41, access upgrade 24, DOI removed 3, venue 2, year 1, arXiv ID removed 1, local code path added 1. zbMATH identifiers recorded for 182 works.
- **Verification values.** `zbmath:<Zbl>`, `arxiv:<id>`, `doi:<doi>` (Crossref): bibliographic record found and matched on title and first author. `explorer-catalogue`: matched to a work the explorer workers read (`data/source-issues.json` or the explorer bibliography); an arXiv ID in parentheses was also confirmed by arXiv. `local:<path>`: the manuscript, roadmap or PDF exists at that local path or git ref. `code-local`: every Mathlib, Tau Ceti or OpenAI path named resolves in the local checkouts. `code (not fetched)`, `web (not fetched)`: repositories and websites accepted as given. `not found`, `ambiguous (…)`: see (d). `unverified (service stopped)`: not checked because a service was stopped or the zbMATH cap was reached.
- **Waves.** `best_wave` is the earliest wave among a work's users (slate waves from `roadmap_leaves.json`; NT sub-roadmaps from `campaign_NT.md`; NT promotion units by order tier, 1 = A, 2 = B, 3 = C; umbrellas by their earliest member; ALG promotion units by their host family).
- **Access rule.** A work was upgraded to `free` or `arxiv` only on evidence: an arXiv ID confirmed by arXiv or listed by zbMATH, an open-archive link listed by zbMATH (Numdam, EuDML, mathdoc, DigiZeitschriften, open repositories), or an explorer catalogue entry recording an arXiv, open-archive or author-hosted copy. Journal papers the compilers marked `free` from memory, and the Ravenel, Ranicki and Cygan et al. books, were set to `library` when no such evidence turned up; other compiler `free` values were kept.

Works not held locally, by access. Order: needed by a wave-A roadmap first, then by number of roadmaps. Code, web resources, roadmaps and OpenAI manuscripts are excluded (all public).

- `Lurie2009Higher` Lurie 2009, *Higher Topos Theory* — pointer unverified (recalled, not read). TOP HomotopicalAlgebra: combinatorial model categories, diagram structures (App. A.2–A.3); TOP InfinityCategories: Joyal structure (§2.2.5), straightening (§2.2.1, §3.2), Kan extensions (§4.3), Ind (§5.3), presentable and adjoint functor theorem (§5.5); pin HTT's definitions and (co)cartesian conventions
- `MilnorStasheff1974Characteristic` Milnor–Stasheff 1974, *Characteristic Classes* — pointer unverified (recalled, not read). TOP CharacteristicClassesAndCobordism: universal bundles (§5–7), SW (§8), Euler (§9), Thom iso (§10), Wu (§11), Chern (§14), Pontryagin (§15), Ω^SO (§17–18), signature (§19); pin its signs: p_i = (−1)^i c_2i(E⊗ℂ), Euler orientation; GEO ConnectionsAndCharacteristicClasses: Appendix C: Chern–Weil and the normalization of Chern and Pontryagin classes
- `Hirschhorn2003Model` Hirschhorn 2003, *Model Categories and Their Localizations* — pointer unverified (recalled, not read). TOP HomotopicalAlgebra: left Bousfield localization (Ch. 3–4), Reedy (Ch. 15), homotopy limits (Ch. 18–19)
- `GoerssJardine2009Simplicial` Goerss–Jardine 2009, *Simplicial Homotopy Theory* — pointer unverified (recalled, not read). TOP HomotopicalAlgebra: Kan–Quillen and |−| ⊣ Sing (Ch. I §11), simplicial model categories (Ch. II), Reedy (Ch. VII)
- `FarbMargalit2012Primer` Farb–Margalit 2012, *Primer on Mapping Class Groups* — pointer unverified (recalled, not read). TOP TeichmullerTheory: Birman (Ch. 4), symplectic rep (Ch. 6), DNB (Ch. 8), Teich and moduli (Ch. 10–12), Nielsen–Thurston (Ch. 13)
- `Walters1982Ergodic` Walters 1982, *Ergodic Theory* — pointer unverified (recalled, not read). PRDS DynamicalSystems: family-wide ergodic-theory and entropy conventions (h_μ(T, ξ), pressure); PRDS ErgodicTheory: Koopman spectral theory, Halmos–von Neumann, weak mixing, Kac; PRDS EntropyAndThermodynamicFormalism: measure-theoretic and topological entropy, variational principle, pressure, equilibrium states (Chs. 4, 7–9)
- `DemboZeitouni1998Large` Dembo–Zeitouni 1998, *Large Deviations Techniques and Applications* — pointer unverified (recalled, not read). PRDS LargeDeviations: the roadmap's spine and conventions (good rate function, speed): Ch. 2 Cramér and Gärtner–Ellis, Ch. 4 contraction, Varadhan, Bryc, projective limits, Ch. 5 Mogulskii and Schilder, Ch. 6 Sanov
- `LyonsPeres2016Probability` Lyons–Peres 2016, *Probability on Trees and Networks* — pointer unverified (recalled, not read). PRDS BernoulliPercolation: transitive graphs: Newman–Schulman, Häggström–Peres, mass transport (Chs. 7–8); PRDS RandomDiscreteStructures: family-wide: networks, spanning forests, branching, unimodularity; PRDS RandomWalksOnGraphsAndNetworks: networks, Rayleigh, Nash-Williams, Wilson, transfer current, UST/USF, mass transport, Kaimanovich–Vershik (Ch. 14); adopt its conventions; PRDS RandomTreesAndMaps: Galton–Watson, branching number, Kesten–Stigum (Chs. 5, 12); COMB GraphTheory/SpectralGraphTheory: Ch. 2 (finite networks): Thomson and Dirichlet principles, Rayleigh monotonicity, effective resistance; Ch. 4: Kirchhoff's formula P(e ∈ T) = R_eff(e), hence Foster's theorem; infinite networks stay with PRDS
- `FriedliVelenik2018Statistical` Friedli–Velenik 2018, *Statistical Mechanics of Lattice Systems* — pointer unverified (recalled, not read). PRDS StatisticalMechanics: family-wide model definitions and normalizations (Ising, Potts, O(n), GFF, Gibbs measures); PRDS LatticeGibbsMeasures: Ising/Potts/O(n)/GFF models, FKG, GKS, Lee–Yang, Peierls, Mermin–Wagner, infrared bounds (Fröhlich–Simon–Spencer); adopt its Hamiltonian normalization (β, h)
